name: Likho
description: Likho is the Slavic personification of bad luck and evil fate, most often depicted as a one-eyed gaunt old woman in black or, more rarely, as a male forest goblin. It is a fairy-tale figure rather than a major mythological deity, woven into proverbs warning against tempting fate.

aliases.name: One-eyed Likho
aliases.meaning: Лихо одноглазое — single-eyed personification of misfortune

origin: Likho is a figure of East and West Slavic folklore, most prominent in Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, and Polish tradition. The figure is woven into proverbs and fairy tales rather than tied to a specific landscape.
